title: Expat family, whole condo near international school
persona: Michael, 41, relocating from London with his wife and two kids (aged 6 and 9).
situation: Wants a family-friendly whole unit; kids will attend an international school in the Bukit Timah area.

turns.content: Hello, we're moving to Singapore in October and need a place for a family of four.
We'd like a 3-bedroom condo, ideally with a pool and gym for the kids. Budget up to $7,000.
Location matters a lot — the children will study around Bukit Timah, so somewhere close would be great.
We have a small dog, is that going to be a problem?
What's typical for the lease length and deposit here? We're not familiar with the local norms.
